sources.title: Superior Court of the Virgin Islands, Holidays (1 V.I.C. § 171(a))
sources.said: In accordance with 1 V.I. Code Ann. § 171(a) of the Virgin Islands Code, the Superior Court of the Virgin Islands recognizes the following legal holidays: January 1 New Year’s Day; January 6 Three King’s Day; Third Monday in January Martin Luther King, Jr., Birthday; Third Monday in February Presidents’ Day; Holy Thursday; Good Friday; Easter Monday; March 31 Transfer Day; Last Monday in May Memorial Day; July 3 V.I. Emancipation Day; July 4 Independence Day; First Monday in September Labor Day; Second Monday in October Columbus Day and Puerto Rico Friendship Day; November 1 D. Hamilton Jackson Day; November 11 Veterans Day; Fourth Thursday in November Thanksgiving Day; December 25 Christmas Day; December 26 Christmas Second Day.

sources.title: St. Thomas Source, Bryan Vetoes Controversial Zoning Variance for Concrete Block Plant (27 April 2023): the bills signed into law
sources.said: Bills that Bryan signed into law include: … Bill No. 35-0009, which enacts the Juneteenth National Independence Day Act to declare June 19 a legal holiday in the Virgin Islands.

sources.title: Government of the U.S. Virgin Islands, Governor Bryan Issues Amended Administrative Leave Schedule for Holiday Observances (22 December 2025)
sources.said: Governor Bryan confirmed that Christmas Day, Thursday, December 25, 2025; Christmas Second Day, Friday, December 26, 2025; New Year’s Day, Thursday, January 1, 2026; and Three Kings’ Day, Tuesday, January 6, 2026, remain recognized legal holidays in the U.S. Virgin Islands. … Territory-Wide … Friday, January 2, 2026 — 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., to allow participation in the St. Croix Crucian Christmas Festival Children’s Parade

sources.title: Government of the U.S. Virgin Islands, Governor Albert Bryan Jr. Announces Government Office Closures for Easter Holiday (30 March 2026)
sources.said: The following days will be observed as official government holidays: Thursday, April 2, 2026 – Holy Thursday; Friday, April 3, 2026 – Good Friday; Monday, April 6, 2026 – Easter Monday.

sources.title: Government of the U.S. Virgin Islands, Governor Bryan Joins Virgin Islands Community in Recognizing Juneteenth; Government Offices to Close Friday (17 June 2026)
sources.said: In observance of Juneteenth, all Government of the Virgin Islands offices will be closed on Friday, June 19.

sources.title: Government of the U.S. Virgin Islands, Governor Bryan Grants Administrative Leave to Non-Essential Government Employees on Nov. 2 and Nov. 27 (19 October 2026)
sources.said: non-essential government employees will receive administrative leave on Monday, Nov. 2, for Liberty Day, and Friday, Nov. 27, the day after Thanksgiving. Non-essential government offices will be closed on both days. … Liberty Day, also known as D. Hamilton Jackson Day, is celebrated each year on Nov. 1. … Because Nov. 1 falls on a Sunday this year, the Governor has granted administrative leave to non-essential employees on Monday, Nov. 2.
